1/5 Spain's 'inexplicable' order (68)
At least 68 dead as a train hits a stopped one. Minister calls letting it restart 'inexplicable'; probe ongoing.

2/5 Israel vote: no majority yet (61)
Partial count: Netanyahu's bloc 53, Eisenkot's bloc 48. Neither reaches 61; Arab-led parties hold a record 19.
📷 Clema12 (CC BY-SA 4.0) via wikimedia

The Fed kept rates at 3.75–4.00% on Wednesday. Two officials wanted a hike: 'Inflation remains elevated.'
📷 Federalreserve (Public domain) via wikimedia

4/5 Bolsonaro lands in Miami (Miami)
Flávio Bolsonaro flew to Miami despite a passport order. He faces a money-laundering probe; he denies wrongdoing.

Milwaukee beat Tampa Bay 4–1 to take the series 4–1. First title since the club was founded in 1969.
